population: strict_benchmark_eligible == true; no length cutoff; structural-review cases and incomplete content excluded from reference, retained in tables
article_weighting: one observation per article; null metrics excluded with missing_count
block_weighting: one observation per block; longer articles contribute more blocks
histogram_policy: 12 shared equal-width bins per metric, derived from the full eligible population
quantile_method: linear interpolation; std is population standard deviation
